summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc., a Canadian gold mining company, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated August 25, 2026, announcing a planned CFO transition. Alexander Dann, the current CFO and VP Finance, will retire after a 35-year career and step down after a transition period. Elijah Tyshynski, formerly CFO of ATEX Resources and O3 Mining, will succeed him as CFO. No financial terms, deal structures, or shareholder actions are mentioned. The filing is a routine management succession announcement, not a forced departure or special-situation event. What to watch: orderly handover and future leadership impact on growth strategy.
